title: Belgium – Construction work – Marché de travaux pour la rénovation et l'extension de l'Administration communale ainsi que du centre sportif de la commune de TROOZ
description: Objet des travaux : Rénovation et extension de l’Administration communale ainsi que du centre sportif de la commune Situation et lieux d’exécution : Les bâtiments se situent : 22 rue de l’Eglise à 4870 TROOZ Parcelles: TROOZ B442s, B441m3, B442t, B442n et B452m. Programme : En juillet 2021, les bâtiments du service de l'administration communale de TROOZ et les bâtiments qui l'entourent, comprenant le hall sportif, la salle des mariages, le CPAS et le service à la population, ont été inondés. L'administration communale souhaite rénover/démolir/reconstruire ces bâtiments et regrouper tous ses services en un même lieu : l'administration communale, le CPAS, le service à la population, ainsi que mutualiser la cafétéria, les vestiaires et les parkings avec le centre sportif. Afin de valoriser le patrimoine architectural de la commune, celle-ci désire rénover le bâtiment de l'administration communale (bâtiment en front de terrain) ainsi que le hall sportif. La salle des mariages, le CPAS et le bâtiment du service à la population seront, quant à eux démolis. Le marché est divisé en lots comme suit : -Lot N° 1 : Architecture, Stabilité, ascenseur (+ maintenance), démolition, abords et coordination des autres lots. -Lot N° 2 : Electricité, détection incendie (+ maintenance) et panneaux photovoltaïques -Lot N° 3 : HVAC, sanitaire (+ maintenance) Coordination des LOTS : Le présent marché prévoit la désignation de l’entreprise du LOT 1 en tant qu’ENTREPRISE COORDINATRICE et les entreprises des LOT 2 et LOT 3 en tant qu' ENTREPRISES COORDONNÉES. Cette coordination est assurée par l’entreprise coordinatrice moyennant un « FEE » de coordination correspondant à sa rémunération pour toutes les prestations de coordination décrites dans le présent cahier des charges. Par le simple fait de remettre offre, les soumissionnaires des LOTS coordonnés marquent leur accord sans réserve sur la procédure définie au présent cahier spécial des charges. L'entreprise coordinatrice assure la mission de pilotage, c’est-à-dire la planification (L’ENTREPRISE COORDINATRICE établit le planning général des travaux en y intégrant le planning d’exécution particulier du LOT 2, et LOT 3 coordonnés), la coordination, et l’organisation du chantier jusqu'à la bonne fin des travaux (y compris réception définitive). Elle assume également, en dehors des charges inhérentes à l'exécution de sa propre entreprise, la mise à disposition des installations sanitaires (conformément au code sur le bien-être au travail) et autres éléments relatifs à l’installation de chantier (repris dans les clauses techniques) pour les entreprises coordonnées. A cet égard, chaque ENTREPRISE COORDONNÉE s'engage et s'oblige à satisfaire aux obligations notifiées pour l'ENTREPRISE COORDINATRICE.

title: Slovakia – Refuse collection services – Nakladanie s komunálnymi odpadmi a drobnými stavebnými odpadmi na území mesta Košice
description: Predmet zákazky je rozdelený na dve časti: 1. Časť – Komunálny odpad (ZKO) Predmetom zákazky je poskytovanie služieb v oblasti nakladania s komunálnymi odpadmi v zmysle tohto opisu predmetu zákazky, okrem iného služieb spojených so zberom, odvozom a spracovaním komunálnych odpadov, dezinfekciou a čistením zberných nádob, ako aj prevádzkovanie zberných dvorov na území mesta Košice vrátane zabezpečenia triedeného zberu. Požiadavky verejného obstarávateľa na zabezpečenie triedeného zberu sú uvedené v Časti 1 bode 1.3 Opisu predmetu zákazky. Služby je potrebné zabezpečiť v súlade s hierarchiou odpadového hospodárstva vyplývajúcou zo zákona č. 79/2015 Z. z. o odpadoch a o zmene a doplnení niektorých zákonov v znení neskorších predpisov (ďalej len „Zákon o odpadoch“) a s ďalšími súvisiacimi právnymi predpismi. Predpokladaný termín začatia poskytovania služby je 1. január 2027. Doba trvania poskytovania služby je stanovená na 120 mesiacov, t. j. do 31. decembra 2036 v prípade účinnosti zmluvy od 01.01.2027. Ak sa tak nestane doba trvania zmluvy bude 120 mesiacov od účinnosti zmluvy. S výnimkou prevádzky zberných dvorov sa všetky služby musia začať poskytovať ku dňu účinnosti zmluvy. V prípade, ak v čase začatia poskytovania služieb nebude dostupný požadovaný počet zberných dvorov, ich uvedenie do prevádzky sa riadi podmienkami špecifikovanými v časti venovanej zberným dvorom, pričom sa umožňuje ich zriadenie a sprevádzkovanie v troch etapách, ako je uvedené ďalej v opise predmetu zákazky. Mesto Košice ako verejný obstarávateľ deklaruje v rámci svojich kompetencií súčinnosť pri legislatívnych a vecných krokoch nevyhnutných na riadne a efektívne poskytovanie predmetných služieb, vrátane zabezpečenia potrebných povolení, informovania obyvateľstva a koordinácie vývoja systému odpadového hospodárstva na svojom území. 2. Časť – Kuchynsky rozložiteľný biologický odpad (KBO) Predmetom zákazky je poskytovanie služieb v oblasti nakladania s komunálnym odpadom (biologicky rozložiteľný kuchynský odpad – katalógové číslo odpadu 20 01 08) v zmysle tohto opisu predmetu zákazky, a to služieb spojených so zberom, odvozom a spracovaním biologicky rozložiteľného kuchynského odpadu. Služby je potrebné zabezpečiť v súlade s hierarchiou odpadového hospodárstva vyplývajúcou zo zákona č. 79/2015 Z. z. o odpadoch a o zmene a doplnení niektorých zákonov v znení neskorších predpisov (ďalej len „Zákon o odpadoch“) a s ďalšími súvisiacimi právnymi predpismi. Predpokladaný termín začatia poskytovania služby je 1. január 2027. Doba trvania poskytovania služby je stanovená na 120 mesiacov, t. j. do 31. decembra 2036 v prípade účinnosti zmluvy od 01.01.2027. Ak sa tak nestane doba trvania zmluvy bude 120 mesiacov od účinnosti zmluvy. Služby sa musia začať poskytovať ku dňu účinnosti zmluvy. Mesto Košice ako verejný obstarávateľ deklaruje v rámci svojich kompetencií súčinnosť pri legislatívnych a vecných krokoch nevyhnutných na riadne a efektívne poskytovanie predmetných služieb, vrátane zabezpečenia potrebných povolení, informovania obyvateľstva a koordinácie vývoja systému odpadového hospodárstva na svojom území.

description: Austro Control GmbH beabsichtigt, die „Lieferung, Inbetriebnahme und laufende Wartung eines integrierten MET-Datenverarbeitungssystems für die Austro Control GmbH“ zu beschaffen. Insbesondere beinhaltet die Beschaffung das Softwarepaket als einheitliches zentralisiertes Gesamtsystem (in weiterer Folge „MET-DS“) für die sechs (6) Flugsicherungsstandorte Salzburg (LOWS), Innsbruck (LOWI), Klagenfurt (LOWK), Linz (LOWL), Graz (LOWG), Wien (LOWW) sowie die Installation und Inbetriebnahme, Dokumentation und IT-Training. Das MET-DS System muss die Grundfunktionalitäten gemäß Leistungsverzeichnis (vgl. LV Pkt. 1.1.) inkludieren. Das MET-DS System muss in die bestehende ACG-Systemumgebung eingebunden werden und es ist grundsätzlich vorgesehen, dass das System on premise von der ACG selbst betrieben wird. Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist die Software; der Betrieb des Systems muss auf der bestehenden von der ACG bereitgestellten Virtualisierungsplattform erfolgen. Die Inbetriebnahme der ATIS/D-ATIS Teile muss bis spätestens 30.06.2028 erfolgreich abgeschlossen sein. Die Lieferung und vollständige Inbetriebnahme müssen bis 30.06.2029 erfolgreich abgeschlossen sein Des Weiteren soll ein unbefristeter Wartungsvertrag (24/7/365) für das neue System beschafft werden, welcher sowohl eine zeitnahe Fehlerbehebung als auch eine Weiterentwicklung gemäß regulatorischen Vorgaben sicherstellt. Der Wartungsvertrag wird unbefristet, mit beidseitiger achtzehn (18) monatiger Kündigungsfrist zum Ende eines Kalenderjahres, abgeschlossen. Der AN sowie AG können jeweils frühestens achtundvierzig (48) Monate (=Kündigungsverzicht) nach Ablauf der Gewährleistungs-/ Garantiefrist kündigen. Der Leistungsort ist Wien und der Leistungsbeginn ist unverzüglich nach Zuschlag. Der Vertrag beginnt nach Abnahme des Systems. Die Zahlung für den Wartungsvertrag erfolgt erstmals nach Ablauf der Gewährleistung von 2 Jahren nach Abnahme. Optional sind folgende Leistungskomponenten anzubieten: • ein Kontingent von 500 Stunden für Tätigkeiten im Sinne des Grundauftrags (vgl. LV Pkt. 1.2) • Extensible Interface Capability (vgl. 14.1 TecSpec) • Operating Mode "MONITOR LOCAL" (vgl. 14.2 TecSpec) • SMA Interface (vgl. 14.3 TecSpec) • Electric Storm Warning (vgl. 14.4 TecSpec) • Alternate Airport for Military Aviation Display (vgl. 14.5 TecSpec) • SWIM Interface (vgl. 14.6 TecSpec). Vergaberechtliche Option gem. § 365 BVergG 2018 sind vorgesehen und in Punkt 1.4 der vergaberechtlichen Bestimmungen genau angeführt. Voraussetzung für ein gültiges Angebot ist die Vorlage eines Original-Vadiums in Papierform spätestens bis zum Zeitpunkt der Angebotsöffnung.

Преглед и анализ на съществуващия Доклад за резултатите от обследването за установяване на техническите характеристики на сградата и на Техническия паспорт на строежа; Преглед и анализ на съществуващия Доклад от извършеното обследване за енергийните характеристики на сградата; Преглед и анализ на оценка за наличие на защитени видове в сградата; Архитектурно заснемане на сградата и геодезическо заснемане на прилежащия терен, при необходимост; Допълнителни проучвания при необходимост, включително подробен оглед на обекта за отразяване на евентуално настъпилите промени след етапа на изготвяне на Обследването за енергийна ефективност (например подменена допълнително дограма и други). Изпълнителят следва да уведоми Възложителя, който осъществява координацията по предварителните проектни дейности; Изготвяне на инвестиционен проект във фаза „Технически проект“ за обекта/секциите от сградата, в обхват и със съдържание съгласно Наредба № 4 от 21.05.2001 г. за обхвата и съдържанието на инвестиционните проекти, законовите и подзаконовите нормативни актове на Република България и в съответствие с изискванията на Възложителя и със задължителните предписания на Докладите за резултатите от обследването за установяване на техническите характеристики на строежа и от извършеното обследване за енергийна ефективност на съответната секция от сградата; Извършване от Изпълнителя на всички необходими дейности по съгласуване на инвестиционния проект с Възложителя и съгласуването на проекта с централни и териториални администрации, специализирани контролни органи и експлоатационни дружества когато такива се налагат; Таксите/разходите за съгласуване и одобрение с изключение на тези към Възложителя са за сметка на Изпълнителя. Отразяване на направените препоръки и забележки в хода на съгласувателните процедури с Възложителя, централни и териториални администрации, специализирани контролни органи и експлоатационни дружества, и на извършване на оценката за съответствие на инвестиционния проект с основните изисквания към строежите от Консултанта; Получаване на всички необходими становища и разрешения, необходими за извършване на неговата работа, съгласно българското законодателство; Законосъобразно, качествено и срочно започване, изпълнение и завършване на строителството, включително доставка на строителни продукти, механизация, работна сила и всякакви услуги и дейности, необходими за изпълнение на строителството в съответствие с техническите спецификации и инвестиционните проекти, съгласно Закона за устройство на територията (ЗУТ) и подзаконовите нормативни актове по прилагането му, всички други действащи нормативни документи, Договора за изпълнението и др.; Своевременно съставяне на актовете и протоколите по време на строителството в съответствие с изискванията на чл. 163, ал. 2, т. 3 от ЗУТ; Съхраняване и предоставяне при поискване от останалите участници в инвестиционния процес или от контролен орган на строителните книжа, заповедната книга на строежа по чл. 170, ал. 3 от ЗУТ, актовете и протоколите, съставени по време на строителството, и друга техническа документация по изпълнението на строежа; Изготвяне на екзекутивна документация съгласно чл. 175 от Закона за устройство на територията; Проби, изпитвания и лабораторни изследвания при завършване на строителните и монтажните работи, където е необходимо; Отстраняване на недостатъците, установени при предаването на Строежа и въвеждането му в експлоатация; Авторски надзор по време на строителството в обем и със съдържание съгласно ЗУТ и подзаконовите нормативни документи по прилагането му; Участие в процедурата по въвеждане на Строежа в експлоатация;​​​​​​​ Отстраняване на всички констатирани дефекти в рамките на гаранционния срок.

description: Predmetom zákazky s názvom „Obstaranie združenej dodávky trakčnej elektriny vrátane zodpovednosti za odchýlku pre potreby tretích osôb na obdobie 12 mesiacov, od 01.01.2027 do 31.12.2027“ je - dodávka elektriny do odberných miest obstarávateľa, ktorých úplný zoznam tvorí Prílohu č. 1 Kapitoly B.1 Opis predmetu zákazky súťažných podkladov, podľa potreby uvedenej v predpokladanom odberovom diagrame, ktorý tvorí Prílohu č. 2 Kapitoly B.1 Opis predmetu zákazky súťažných podkladov, v požadovanej kvalite a s garanciou dodávky elektriny po celú dobu platnosti zmluvy o združenej dodávke elektriny uzatvorenej na základe výsledku verejnej súťaže; - zabezpečenie distribúcie elektriny, regulovaných distribučných služieb od prevádzkovateľa distribučnej sústavy, ku ktorej sú odberné miesta pripojené, zabezpečenie ostatných súvisiacich služieb, vrátane odvodu do Národného jadrového fondu podľa nariadenia vlády č. 21/2019 Z. z., ktorým sa ustanovuje výška ročného odvodu určeného na úhradu historického dlhu z dodanej elektriny koncovým odberateľom elektriny a podrobnosti o spôsobe jeho výberu pre Národný jadrový fond, jeho použití a o spôsobe a lehotách jeho úhrady v znení neskorších predpisov; - prevzatie zodpovednosti za odchýlku obstarávateľa v celom rozsahu, za všetky odberné miesta, v súlade s vyhláškou č. 207/2023 Z. z., ktorou sa ustanovujú pravidlá pre fungovanie vnútorného trhu s elektrinou, obsahové náležitosti prevádzkového poriadku prevádzkovateľa sústavy, organizátora krátkodobého trhu s elektrinou a rozsah obchodných podmienok, ktoré sú súčasťou prevádzkového poriadku prevádzkovateľa sústavy v znení neskorších predpisov, voči zúčtovateľovi odchýlok. Prevzatie zodpovednosti za odchýlku obstarávateľa v celom rozsahu, voči zúčtovateľovi odchýlok, bude súčasťou poplatku uchádzača za nákup elektrickej energie, vypočítaného a vyjadreného v EUR bez DPH / MWh, zaokrúhleného na tri (3) desatinné miesta, ktorý je kritériom na vyhodnotenie ponúk, resp. celkovej ceny za dodanie elektriny dodanej do odberných miest obstarávateľa, stanovenej v súlade s podmienkami uvedenými v súťažných podkladoch. Predmetom zákazky je ďalej záväzok uzatvoriť s obstarávateľom Zmluvu o dodávke prebytkov elektriny a prevzatí zodpovednosti za odchýlku, a to vo vzťahu k elektrine vyrobenej železničnými hnacími koľajovými vozidlami pomocou elektrodynamickej rekuperačnej brzdy, ktorá nebola v čase jej výroby spotrebovaná, v predpokladanom množstve neprevyšujúcom 8.000 MWh elektriny za obdobie platnosti zmluvy o dodávke prebytkov elektriny (ďalej aj ako „predmet zákazky“ v príslušnom gramatickom tvare). Podrobný opis predmetu zákazky je uvedený v súťažných podkladoch (ďalej aj ako "SP").

title: General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT) - Intent to Sole Source
description: General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT) - Intent to Sole Source In accordance with The FAA Acquisition Management System (AMS), section 3.2.2.4, Single Source Selection, the purpose of this announcement is to inform industry of the basis for the FAA's decision to contract on a single source bases to GDIT. The FAA requires its administrative voice services to remain stable during the 2026-2028 timeframe, when virtually every Government Furnished Equipment (GFE)/commercial telecommunication infrastructure and connection link that FAVES relies upon will be undergoing transition to new contracts and/or transformation. This includes all of the FAA�s telecommunications �dial-tone� connections, the FAA�s Toll Free services, the FAVES core, FAVES Primary Rate Interface (PRI) circuit connectivity and the FAA�s FTI Mission Support Wide Area Network (MS-WAN). The risk of disruption to the FAA�s mission essential administrative voice services will already be extremely high because all underlying agency telephony (i.e. the technology associated with the electronic transmission of voice, fax, or other information between distant parties) and WAN connections are undergoing technology transitions and transformations. The FAA cannot tolerate the increased risk to agency administrative communications created by a FAVES contractor platform transition at the same time that these other major transitions are taking place. The FAA must ensure that mission essential services remain stable during several other related major FAA telecommunications and IT transitions planned to occur over the next 3-5 years. This announcement is for informational purposes only. A competitive solicitation is not available for this procurement. The FAA is not liable for any costs associated with the preparing of a response to this announcement. Any questions or comments about this announcement may be directed to the Contracting Officer, Michael E. Tekle, email, no later than 12:00 PM EDT on October 27, 2026.

title: Fort Cambell, KY Full Food Service, Dining Facility Attendant, and Cook Support
description: Pre-Solicitation Notice The Mission Installation Contracting Command - Installation Readiness Center (MICC-IRC) has a requirement from the Army Sustainment Command (ASC) in support of the Logistics Readiness Center (LRC) to procure Full Food Service (FFS), Dining Facility Attendant (DFA), and Cook Support (CS) services under the Army Food Program to provide quality services in support of the installation food service program that supports the Warfighter with flexible, efficient and cost-effective service. Requirement: The service outlined encompasses dining facility management functions, to include food receiving and storage, food preparation, food serving, remote site feeding, and facility sanitation at Fort Campbell, KY (FCKY). The Contractor shall provide the appropriate amount of qualified labor and management with required training, skills, and experience in order to effectively accomplish the work required by the PWS upon posting of the solicitation. The Randolph-Sheppard Act does apply to this solicitation. Background: The current contract is W9128J20D0006 and Task Order W91248-26-F-A025, was awarded to the Kentucky Vocational Rehabilitation � Blind Services Division (KOVRBSD). The period of performance was executed as follows: twelve (12) - month bridge. Contract Period of Performance: The estimated Period of Performance includes a 12-Month Base period and four (4) consecutive 12-Month Order Periods and/or FAR 52.217-8 Option to Extend Services for up to six (6) months. Set Asides and Codes: 100% Small Business Set-aside and subject to the Randolph Shepard Act. The North American Industrial Classification Code (NAICS) for this potential requirement would be 722310, � Food Service Contractors� The related size standard is $47,000,000. The Product Service Code (PSC) is M1FD � Housekeeping- Food. Selection Process: Request for Proposals. Anticipated Solicitation Release Date: The government anticipates releasing the solicitation around early-November. The closing date for Proposal will be approximately twenty (20) days later. Actual dates and times will be identified in the solicitation. Responses to this synopsis are not required. Additional details may be found in the solicitation when it is posted. System for Award Management (SAM): Offerors must register in the SAM at https://www.sam.gov/portal/public/SAM/ prior to submission of bids and prior to receiving an award. Point of Contact: The point of contact for this action is Contract Specialist: David W. Fedison at david.w.fedison.civ@army.mil. The secondary point of contact is Contracting Officer Javelin M. Carouthers at Javelin.m.carouthers.civ@army.mil. THIS PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE IS FOR THE PURPOSE OF INFORMING INDUSTRY THAT THIS SOLICITATION WILL BE POSTED ON SAM.GOV. THIS NOTICE IS NOT A REQUEST FOR QUOTE OR PROPOSAL AND DOCUMENTS RECEIVED AS A RESULT OF THIS PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED OR EVALUATED. THE GOVERNMENT RESERVES THE RIGHT TO CANCEL THIS SOLICITATION EITHER BEFORE OR AFTER THE CLOSING DATE. NO REIMBURSEMENT WILL BE MADE FOR ANY COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH PROVIDING INFORMATION IN RESPONSE TO THIS PRESOLICITATION NOTICE OR ANY FOLLOW-UP INFORMATION REQUEST.

title: Shipboard Fairbanks Morse Diesel Engine System Sustainment Plan (SSP)
description: 1.0 PURPOSE AND BACKGROUND PAE Maritime is conducting market research to identify responsible sources capable of providing some or all the sustainment capabilities required to support U.S. Navy surface-ship Fairbanks Morse Defense Diesel engines worldwide. The information received will help the Government assess available industry capabilities and determine an appropriate acquisition strategy, contract structure, and number of sources. The Navy�s Diesel Engine System Sustainment Plan (SSP) establishes a standardized, scalable approach intended to improve materiel condition and operational availability across multiple Fairbanks Morse Defense Diesel engines ship classes, and geographically dispersed maintenance activities. The contemplated scope includes maintenance, technical expertise, materiel, rotable inventory management, engineering, logistics, training, and emergent field services. The Government is considering a range of acquisition approaches, which may include a single-award Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract, multiple contracts, or coordinated capabilities from multiple sources. No final acquisition strategy has been selected. Respondents may describe capabilities they can provide individually, through existing or proposed teaming arrangements, or as part of a broader sustainment solution. 2.0 CONTEMPLATED SUSTAINMENT CAPABILITIES The Government is seeking information on the capabilities summarized below. Respondents may address any one or more capability areas. For each area addressed, identify current capabilities, how the work would be performed, and any relevant limitations, dependencies, or capability-development needs. 2.1 Diesel Materiel Support This capability includes identifying, sourcing, procuring, managing, and delivering "Pit Stop" CONEX boxes, including configuration-specific repair parts, assemblies, and overhaul materiel for planned maintenance, emergent repairs, casualty response, and restoration of Fairbanks Morse Diesel engines. This capability includes establishing and managing rotable inventories and Overhaul Parts Packages (OPPs), including storage, configuration control, issue and return, repair or overhaul, replenishment, transportation, and positioning inventory to support geographically dispersed maintenance activities. This capability may include configuration-specific engineering and technical assistance, technical data and documentation, maintenance procedures, failure and root-cause analysis, technical dispositions, reliability and maintainability support, obsolescence management, and other Integrated Product Support. 2.2 Embedded Fairbanks Morse Diesel Engine Technical Expertise at SIMAs The Government is considering embedded Fairbanks Morse Diesel engine technical expertise at designated Navy Shore Intermediate Maintenance Activities (SIMAs) to support Sailor training and Navy-led maintenance activities. Support may include hands-on instruction, troubleshooting, maintenance planning, and technical oversight. 2.3 Fairbanks Morse Diesel Engine Overhaul and Unit Exchange Fairbanks Morse Diesel Engine Overhaul and Unit Exchange include comprehensive plant assessment, troubleshooting, corrective maintenance, component repair or replacement, core removal for refurbishment, in-place engine overhaul, testing, and restoration of the engines to operational condition within US Navy Fleet Concentration areas within the United States. Major Engine Overhaul and Unit Exchange must be completed within a mandatory maintenance window of 45 days or less. Respondents should identify relevant experience, available personnel and facilities, configuration coverage, and demonstrated ability to meet this schedule. 2.4 Global Unplanned and Emergent Field Services This capability includes responsive technical troubleshooting, on-site assessment, engineering assistance, repair recommendations, identification and sourcing of required materiel, and other field services needed to restore diesel engine capability at Navy locations worldwide. Respondents should describe geographic coverage, response capability, and the ability to support emergent work while meeting scheduled maintenance commitments. 3.0 CAPABILITY CERTIFICATION MATRIX AND SUPPORTING EVIDENCE Respondents should identify their ability to fulfill each capability area addressed. For each area, identify the proposed method of performance: organic capability, existing OEM or license arrangement, subcontractor or teaming partner, or capability to be developed. Respondents may identify capabilities available through subcontractors, teaming partners, suppliers, license agreements, or other third-party arrangements. Clearly identify the organization responsible for each capability and whether the relationship is established or would need to be formed. Distinguish current capabilities from those that would require additional agreements, licensing, qualification, investment, or development. Provide concise, specific, and verifiable supporting information for each response, as applicable. Useful evidence may include: Relevant contracts or programs, customers, periods of performance, and scope of work; Fairbanks Morse Defense Diesel engine configurations or comparable equipment supported and geographic locations served; Personnel, facilities, tooling, diagnostic or test equipment, inventory, and logistics infrastructure; Demonstrated maintenance capacity, schedule performance, response times, and relevant past performance; and Access to technical data, licenses, specialized resources, or other arrangements necessary to perform the work, including any material limitations. Respondents are not expected to provide a detailed technical proposal or develop a new solution in response to this notice. Concise statements sufficient to describe the respondent�s capabilities and approach are encouraged. 4.0 RESPONSE FORMAT Responses should not exceed 3 pages. Respondents need only address the capability areas relevant to their organization and proposed approach. Please include: Company name and address, UEI, CAGE code, and business size/status; Primary point of contact, including email and telephone number; A concise description of the capability areas addressed and the proposed method of performance; Specific supporting statements for each capability area response, including relevant past performance where available; and Identification of any relevant teaming, subcontracting, licensing, technical-data access, or other third-party arrangements and their status. Responses may be submitted by a single organization or describe capabilities provided by a joint venture, contractor team, subcontractors, suppliers, licensors, or other partners. For proposed teams, identify the participating organizations, the capabilities each would provide, and whether the arrangement is currently established or contingent on future agreement. 5.0 GOVERNMENT USE OF RESPONSES This notice is for market research and is not requested for competitive proposals or quotations; it does not constitute a solicitation. The Government may use responses, together with other available market research, to assess the availability of sources capable of satisfying individual requirements or combinations of requirements; the feasibility of a single-source, multiple-source, or integrated-team approach; and the appropriate acquisition strategy and contract structure. The Government has not made a final determination regarding the acquisition strategy or source selection approach. The Government will not reimburse respondents for costs incurred in preparing or submitting a response and is under no obligation to use information received. Questions should be submitted in writing to the Contract Specialist and/or Contracting Officer identified in the SAM.gov notice. title: Shipboard Air Conditioning Plant System Sustainment Plan (SSP)
description: 1.0 PURPOSE AND BACKGROUND PAE Maritime is conducting market research to identify responsible sources capable of providing some or all the sustainment capabilities required to support U.S. Navy surface-ship centrifugal, reciprocating, and rotary air conditioning (AC) plants worldwide. The information received will help the Government assess available industry capabilities and determine an appropriate acquisition strategy, contract structure, and number of sources. The Navy�s AC Plant System Sustainment Plan (SSP) establishes a standardized, scalable approach intended to improve materiel condition and operational availability across multiple AC plant configurations, ship classes, and geographically dispersed maintenance activities. The contemplated scope includes maintenance, technical expertise, materiel, rotable inventory management, engineering, logistics, training, and emergent field services. The Government is considering a range of acquisition approaches, which may include a single-award Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract, multiple contracts, or coordinated capabilities from multiple sources. No final acquisition strategy has been selected. Respondents may describe capabilities they can provide individually, through existing or proposed teaming arrangements, or as part of a broader sustainment solution. 2.0 CONTEMPLATED SUSTAINMENT CAPABILITIES The Government is seeking information on the capabilities summarized below and detailed in the Capability Certification Matrix (Table 1). Respondents may address any one or more capability areas. For each area addressed, identify current capabilities, how the work would be performed, and any relevant limitations, dependencies, or capability-development needs. 2.1 Major AC Plant Pit Stops Major Pit Stops include comprehensive plant assessment, troubleshooting, corrective maintenance, component repair or replacement, in-place compressor overhaul, testing, and restoration of the plant to operational condition. Major Pit Stops must be completed within a mandatory maintenance window of six weeks or less. Respondents should identify relevant experience, available personnel and facilities, configuration coverage, and demonstrated ability to meet this schedule. 2.2 Embedded AC&R Technical Expertise at SIMAs The Government is considering embedded air conditioning and refrigeration (AC&R) expertise at designated Navy Shore Intermediate Maintenance Activities (SIMAs) to support Sailor training and Navy-led Minor Pit Stops. Support may include hands-on instruction, troubleshooting, maintenance planning, and technical oversight. Minor Pit Stops must also be completed within a mandatory maintenance window of six weeks or less. 2.3 AC Plant Materiel Support This capability includes identifying, sourcing, procuring, managing, and delivering configuration-specific repair parts, components, assemblies, and overhaul materiel for planned maintenance, emergent repairs, casualty response, and restoration of AC plant capability. 2.4 Global Warehouse and Rotable Pool Management This capability includes establishing and managing rotable inventories and Overhaul Parts Packages (OPPs), including storage, configuration control, issue and return, repair or overhaul, replenishment, transportation, and positioning inventory to support geographically dispersed maintenance activities. 2.5 Engineering, Technical Data, Logistics, and Integrated Product Support This capability may include configuration-specific engineering and technical assistance, technical data and documentation, maintenance procedures, failure and root-cause analysis, technical dispositions, reliability and maintainability support, obsolescence management, and other Integrated Product Support. 2.6 Global Unplanned and Emergent Field Services This capability includes responsive technical troubleshooting, on-site assessment, engineering assistance, repair recommendations, identification and sourcing of required materiel, and other field services needed to restore AC plant capability at Navy locations worldwide. Respondents should describe geographic coverage, response capability, and the ability to support emergent work while meeting scheduled maintenance commitments. 3.0 CAPABILITY CERTIFICATION MATRIX AND SUPPORTING EVIDENCE Respondents should complete Table 1 for each capability area addressed. For each area, select YES, PARTIAL, or NO and identify the proposed method of performance: organic capability, existing OEM or license arrangement, subcontractor or teaming partner, or capability to be developed. A response of YES should reflect current capability. PARTIAL should identify the elements currently available and any gaps. NO indicates that the respondent does not currently possess the capability. Respondents may identify capabilities available through subcontractors, teaming partners, suppliers, license agreements, or other third-party arrangements. Clearly identify the organization responsible for each capability and whether the relationship is established or would need to be formed. title: Netherlands – Construction work – Bouwteampartner parkeergebouw Poort van Hoorn
description: De gemeente Hoorn geeft binnen het project Poort van Hoorn invulling aan een omvangrijke herontwikkeling van het stationsgebied. In het stationsgebied zullen de komende jaren diverse ontwikkelingen plaatsvinden op het gebied van woningbouw, voorzieningen, mobiliteit en openbare ruimte. Als onderdeel van deze transformatie realiseert de gemeente aan de noordzijde van het Stationsgebied een parkeergebouw voor zowel de auto (P+R) als de fiets, inclusief de ov-fiets, dat fungeert als vliegwiel voor verdere stedelijke ontwikkeling. De nieuwe parkeergarage, 6 bouwlagen en een fietsparkeerkelder, maakt het mogelijk om bestaande parkeerplaatsen op maaiveld te saneren en ruimte vrij te spelen voor geplande woningbouw en kwalitatieve inrichting van het gebied binnen het project Poort van Hoorn-stationsgebied. Hiermee wordt een compacte en efficiënte mobiliteitsoplossing gerealiseerd die bijdraagt aan de ambitie van Hoorn om zich te ontwikkelen tot een leefbare en bereikbare stad. Zie aanbestedingsdocumenten.

title: Hochrangige Regierungsberatung in Osteuropa, auf dem Westbalkan, im Südkaukasus und in Zentralasien - Beratungsleistungen zur Unterstützung wirtschaftspolitischer Reformprozesse
description: Die hochrangige Regierungsberatung wird in Staaten in Osteuropa, auf dem Westbalkan, im Südkaukasus und in Zentralasien durchgeführt. Aktuell erfolgt die Beratung in den Ländern Ukraine, Belarus (derzeit ausgesetzt), Moldau, Georgien (derzeit ausgesetzt), Usbekistan und Kosovo. Ab 2027 soll die Beratung in den Ländern Ukraine, Moldau, Usbekistan, Kosovo, Albanien und Nordmazedonien erfolgen. Bei Bereitstellung zusätzlicher Haushaltsmittel ist als weiteres Programmland Armenien vorgesehen. Kern und Voraussetzung für die Akzeptanz der Beratung bei den Regierungen der Zielländer ist die Unabhängigkeit und Nachfrageorientierung der Beratung. Die Beratung wird auf Wunsch und Nachfrage von Institutionen des Partnerlandes erbracht. Die konkreten Themen für die wirtschaftspolitische Beratung werden vorrangig von Institutionen und Regierungsstellen der Partnerländer dem AN oder dem BMWE gegenüber vorgeschlagen. Damit ergänzt die Regierungsberatung das Instrumentarium der Außenwirtschaftsförderinstrumente, die sich vornehmlich an Unternehmen richten. Der AN tritt in der Ausführung des Auftrags als eigenständiger Akteur auf. Der AN hat in Abstimmung mit dem AG auf das Auftragsverhältnis zu verweisen.

Tuotteen tulee olla standardin EN 17353 mukainen käyttötarkoituksensa mukaisessa tuoteluokassa. Standardi koskee keskisuuren riskin tilanteisiin tarkoitettuja näkyvyyttä parantavia vaatteita ja varusteita, ja siinä asetetaan vaatimuksia muun muassa värille, heijastavuudelle, materiaalien vähimmäispinta-aloille ja materiaalien sijoittelulle tuotteessa. - Liivin tulee soveltua lasten (ja aikuisten) ulkokäyttöön eri vuodenaikoina. - Liivissä tulee olla tarrakiinnitys tai muu vastaava helposti käytettävä ja turvallinen kiinnitystapa. - Liivissä tulee olla vähintään kaksi vartalon ympäri kiertävää heijastavaa nauhaa tai muu standardin EN 17353 mukainen rakenne, joka täyttää tuotteelle soveltuvan näkyvyysluokan vaatimukset. - Tuotteen tulee olla CE-merkitty. Tarjouspyynnössä hankinnan kohteen kriteerit kohdassa ilmoitetut tuotteet edustavat eniten hankittavia tuotteita sopimuskauden aikana ja volyymit ovat arvioita kulutusmääristä / vuosi. Ilmoitetut volyymit perustuvat vuoden 2025 ostomääriin ja ovat suuntaa antavia. Volyymit on ilmoitettu sitoumuksetta. Tilaaja ei sitoudu sopimusajalla kiinteisiin hankintamääriin eikä tiettyihin tuotteisiin, vaan tuotteita hankintaa sopimuskauden aikana tarpeita vastaavasti.,
